integrity: All quantifiers, integer-program constraints, branch conditions, and polynomial sign arguments are explicit. The proof distinguishes the universal algebraic argument from finite verification scans. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the maximum cardinality for every alphabet size q at least ten, but does not classify or count all maximum codes and does not address lengths seven and above. The universal claim is proved symbolically from the exact SQN formulation; finite exact computations are reported only as checks.
title: Blackburn optimality for length-six non-overlapping codes from alphabet size ten
